notes.title: Hello to Japanese players ! (new demo update)
notes.notes:
Hello dear lunar knights!

I'm so glad to update the demo of Last Moon today with Japanese language available and many improvements made in terms of performance, gameplay and rendering!! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35286407/42d6aa2bd4dbfedd3e20b007961f458aab017263.png

Here is a little patch note :


 Japanese language added.
 Most of bugs reported by players have been fixed.
 Scenes are now merged into large areas to have few loading screens as possible and to make exploration more immersive and closer to an open world.
 Camera system have been totally reworked to upgrade fluidity and erase jitter/lag effect.
 A huge work have been made on optimization to improve loading speed and performances.
 Movements gamefeel and inputs have been reworked and are now more responsive.
 Co-op and solo mode has been rebalanced (players damage, speed and enemies HP revised) to be more fun.
 Some menus and ui navigation have been improved to be more intuitive and sexy.
 Lvl design and the demo ending have been modified a bit to fit in with the evolution of the game as it will be in 1.0.


I'm very excited with how the game is going and to continue to make so much progress on its development. I hope you enjoy this new demo!
Cheers,
Sköll Studio

notes.title: First Update !
notes.notes:
Hello to all Lunar Knights!

Following your initial feedback on the demo, I decided to launch a small update in order to add some features that were asked by the players!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35286407/f8cf8e14f6c6f907c5928279ebbdedfdc5666502.png

patch note:
- Vsync, infact it was already here but not easy to find, you could activate it by going to the left in the framerate selection. Vsync is now selectable under the framerate (more logical, it's true).
- An “Auto Run” mode  (in the gameplay menu) which has been requested several times!
- An accessibility mode which makes player 1 and/or 2 invincible. Accessibility mode will offer several options in the future.

Thank you for your awesome feedbacks and good game to all!
It's very heartwarming to finally have players traveling through the If region.

- Vincent -
